  technology: HTTPS (langchain4j clients, AWS SDK)

Hosted LLM APIs the plugin calls for chat and agent turns: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral, Groq, DeepInfra, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, xAI Grok, Kimi, GLM, NVIDIA and Cloudflare Workers AI. Users supply their own API keys.
